purpose: RSS Atlas discovery queries, not endorsements or automatically subscribed feeds
review_rules: Directory ranking is not evidence of authority or topic relevance.
Keep each feed as a candidate until the endpoint is successfully retrieved.
Filter articles by actual relevance to AI, not only site category.
Preserve original title, author, publication URL, and discovery provenance.
Separate primary reporting from rediscovery aggregators and institutional positions.
Prefer original authors and papers over summaries copied from other feeds.
